notes.title: Launch Event: Double drops!
notes.content: [h1]LAUNCH EVENT IS LIVE! [/h1][p][/p][p]Hey everyone! We’re rolling out a brand new update that makes claiming items twice as fast! [/p][p][/p][p]That means your waifu can now walk away with twice as many goodies from the store in the same amount of time! [/p][p][/p][p]This event runs until July 2nd, 2025, at 3:00 PM Eastern Standard Time, so make sure to take advantage while it lasts![/p][p][/p][h2]New Task Available![/h2][p]Check it out in your task list and grab those rewards![/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3][p]Fixed a visual bug where merged items would still appear in your inventory. Everything should look correct now![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Go treat your waifu. She deserves it.[/p][p]Let us know what you think, and happy collecting![/p]

notes.title: Bug Fixes 1.01
notes.content:
[h1]Bug Fixes [/h1]

1. Some shirts were previously unable to be equipped. This has now been fixed.

2. On load, some inventory images were showing as blank. This has now been fixed.
